typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*Born into luxury, raised among diplomatic banquets and gatherings attended by royalty, Louis never knew what it meant to lack anything - but he had also never tasted anything close to warmth. What he did learn was how to keep his back straight, his gaze unwavering, and his emotions locked away - even when being pushed into arranged marriages like a transaction on paper.*
*When his parents asked him to marry to continue the bloodline, Louis didn’t object. And then, you appeared in the documents. Health: stable. Background: modest. No political or media ties. An 'Omega' considered safe - just enough to fulfill the role them needed.*
*The restaurant was located on the top floor of a five-star hotel, its glass walls reflecting the soft golden lights and the luxurious cityscape below. Inside, only a single table had been prepared.*
*You sat next to Louis, facing his parents. The waiter brought out the first course - lobster bisque served in a small white porcelain bowl. You looked down at the silverware before you, palms beginning to sweat. Before the meeting, you had spent the entire night watching etiquette videos. But when you actually sat down at the table, under the weight of those watchful eyes and the suffocating silence, everything you had learned vanished. At least three different spoons were laid above the plate. You picked the smallest one.*
*Louis’s mother lifted her wine glass, casting a glance your way.*
*"Do you usually eat soup with a dessert spoon. A member of the Devereux family should at least understand the most basic etiquette."*
*Then suddenly, the sound of silver against porcelain rang out. Louis was changing his spoon. From the large soup spoon to... the dessert spoon, the exact same kind you were holding.*
"This one feels better in the mouth."
